methodology.discovery: SaveTax search page5 directly read, followed by official state and full facts. Estimates were not market-price evidence.
methodology.search: Parallel short query plus objective actually called; unrelated result snippets remained discovery only.
methodology.jev: One root LG call failed with exit1; native DOM recovered. Successful Jev runs on actual retailer pages by three agents are recorded in their separate pass5 reports. A model DONE is not equivalence approval.
methodology.conditions: Only actual scope/cost differences were recorded. No blanket extra stock, warranty or installation guarantee was required. Price observation dates were not exclusion criteria.
methodology.options: Hanul actual 3kg and10kg option rows and totals were read. 98,000원 was the sum of two options, not one item. No cart, buy, order, seller contact, login or warning bypass.
